name: a-later-answer-on-the-key-replaces-every-item
description: The items of one answer are one emission (5.4): the three keyed forwards of the first answer all run at b, none making another stale. The later answer of a on the same key makes every one of them stale at its first forward (three drops, in the order the work was created), and its own two items replace them together: both run and answer.
